Toll Protest Turns Violent in Thrissur, Minister Intervenes

A protest against toll collection on the National Highway in Thrissur, Kerala, turned violent. The protest, organized by the UDF, was related to the incomplete status of the road. A minister intervened in the situation as it became tense.
